narr: A slow moving system brought a training band of thunderstorms with heavy rain to portions of the Florida panhandle, which resulted in some reports of flooding. Rainfall amounts of 5-8 inches were measured.
ev: Flooding was reported at the 22400 Block of Blountstown Highway.
Flash flooding was reported on Old Bethel Road.
The Bay County Sheriff's Office reported that 23rd Street near the Golden Corral was becoming impassible due to flash flooding.
Alf Coleman Road was becoming impassible near the beach due to flash flooding.
